scope:
Join completed background diagnostics to recorded numerical references.

Retain capture/replay differences instead of silently using a fresh DT vector
as the original prediction. The old 165-point diagnostic collection is not the
1061-point probability sample and cannot supply a new method's recall.

textcraft.inference: Original prediction-tail census classification only. Do not compute precision or recall of the single-background diagnostic from this selected subset or append old queries to the new sample.

appworld.inference: Original prediction-tail census classification only. Do not compute precision or recall of the single-background diagnostic from this selected subset or append old queries to the new sample.

interpretation: Algebraic error ledger and paired diagnostic measurements only. No term is removed from credit, no new pass threshold is used, and a local term magnitude is not a causal share of global error. Reference ranges include every matching recorded view and are not rigorous oracle bounds. A single-background diagnostic with extra DT calls is not a cost-compliant training method.
